question: If Δ ABC~Δ FDE such that AB = 9 cm, AC = 11 cm, DF = 16 cm and DE = 12 cm, then the length of BC is:
solution:
**Given:**

AB = 9 cm, AC = 11 cm, DF = 16 cm and DE = 12 cm

**Concept used:**

When two triangles are similar, their corresponding angles are equal and their corresponding sides are proportional.

**Calculation:**

As ΔABC ~ ΔFDE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a35171e72d74596a2b55de4b43267a99714e1264fdeb5b477af8036912b1456.png] 

So, AB/DF = BC/DE = AC/FE

Now,

AB/DF = BC/DE

⇒ 9/16 = BC/12

⇒ BC = (9 × 12)/16

⇒ BC = 27/4

⇒ BC = 6(3)/(4) cm

**∴ The length of BC is 6(3)/(4).**
